name: sit-schema
reply:
Schema migration for customer contact data, ready to apply on dev first.

The customers table currently stores contact details in two columns, email and phone, and a free text column called notes that has been used for second emails. The migration adds a contacts table with columns id, customer_id, kind, value and is_primary, with a foreign key to customers and an index on customer_id. A backfill copies each email and phone into a contacts row and marks them primary. The old email and phone columns stay for one release and are dropped in a later migration.

Row counts: 18,400 customers become about 31,000 contacts. The migration takes about 40 seconds on the dev copy. Rollback drops the new table; the old columns are untouched, so nothing is lost if we stop.
